title: ecbolium linaria
intro: Ecbolium linaria, commonly known as "Fingered Bells" or "Fingered Bellflower", is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is an annual or biennial herb with medicinal properties, used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium linaria include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Ecbolium linaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
